intent: One conversation on a document, invoice or task: comments, one level of replies, @mentions shown as brand text, in-place edit and delete for your own comments (in a More menu), and a composer. Not the assistant Chat. Built on kit Avatar, Textarea, Button, DropdownMenu, Kbd and AlertDialog.
useWhen: people discuss a record (invoice, document, task) with replies and @mentions
show the thread for one line or the whole page
inside CommentsPanel for the selected thread
doNotUseWhen: a list of threads on a page — CommentsPanel

title.note: Shows the card header with the count. Omit inside CommentsPanel.

comments.note: { id, author: { id, name, initials?, avatarSrc? }, createdAt, body, edited?, parentId? }[]; replies nest one level. createdAt is shown in mono as given: use one format, e.g. "Nov 20, 10:03". "@Full Name" of anyone in the thread renders as a mention.

currentUserId.note: Your comments get Edit and Delete.

members.note: { id, name, initials?, avatarSrc?, role? }[]. Typing @ in the composer opens this list above the field (a combobox listbox): arrows move, Enter inserts "@Full Name ", Escape closes and keeps the text.

onSubmit.note: Comment, an md Button on the composer row; ⌘/Ctrl+Enter posts.

submitAppearance.note: soft when another solid primary shares the view (e.g. ChangeReview's Accept all).

onReply.note: (id) => void; one ghost sm Reply under each top-level thread; focus moves to the composer.

onEdit.note: (id, body) => void. From the More menu. Enter saves, Escape cancels; focus returns to More.

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h3 title (or aria-label when untitled)
comments and replies are nested lists
Reply buttons say whom they reply to (described by the author name)
mentions are brand text at heading weight, inside the sentence, so they read in order
with members, the composer is a combobox: @ opens a listbox above it, arrow keys move, Enter inserts, Escape closes and keeps the typed text; each option reads name and role
Edit and Delete sit in a kit DropdownMenu named "More actions on your comment"
the composer and the edit field are labelled Textareas; the composer is described by its "⌘ Enter to send" hint; ⌘/Ctrl+Enter posts, Enter saves an edit, Escape cancels and focus returns to More
Delete confirms with a kit AlertDialog
Sending is announced in a status region; aria-busy while sending or loading
new comments fade and rise in on transform and opacity, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not use Chat for people commenting on a record
Do not nest replies more than one level
Do not style Reply, Edit or Delete as text links: Reply is a ghost sm Button, Edit and Delete live in the More menu
Do not show more than one solid primary; Comment is it unless submitAppearance is soft
snippet: <CommentThread title="Invoice INV-1842" comments={comments} members={team} currentUserId={me.id} value={draft} onValueChange={setDraft} onSubmit={post} onReply={reply} onEdit={edit} onDelete={remove} />
